div.head: Cn 1018
div.ab: And witena gerædnes is þæt hi willað. þæt ælces hades men georne gebugan. ælc to ðam rihte þe him to gebyrige. 7 huruþinga. godes þeowas. biscopas. 7 abbodas. munecas. 7 minicena. canonicas. 7 nunnan to rihte gebugan. 7 regollice libban. 7 dæges. 7 nihtes oft 7 gelome. clipian to criste. 7 for eal cristen folc þingian georne.

And the decree of the councillors is that they desire that men of every rank zealously submit, each to the duty which is appropriate to him, and certainly [that] the servants of God, bishops and abbots, monks and nuns, canons and women dedicated to God, submit to their duty, and live according to their rule, and day and night, often and frequently, call upon Christ, and zealously intercede for all Christian people.
